summary: A USDINR future on CDS at Quote: Tradejini's currency prices are integers over 10,000,000, not 100.

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
The web sends the future's open interest (L1 OI) in Quote; the desktop's Quote frame leaves OI out unless Depth is held for the instrument.

The web also sends the trade time as last_trade_time (the same local-time text as its ltt, a web defect); the desktop sends no last_trade_time for Tradejini. Phase B: the dialect alias in epoch ms beside ltt, as Samco, 5paisa and mStock have it (feed::dialect, lane wire); the value then stays a declared web defect.

The desktop rounds Tradejini's change to two decimals (round2 in TradejiniFeed::tick): 0.76 where Tradejini sent 0.7625 for a currency future, whose prices carry four (divisor 1e7). The web passes the change as sent. Phase B: keep the change as Tradejini sends it.

Two causes: the rounding of change (0.76 for Tradejini's 0.7625), and the canonical price_change the web's Tradejini adapter never sends (follows the web adapter once wire's switch covers instruments).
The canonical price_change_percent the web's Tradejini adapter never sends (follows the web adapter once wire's switch covers instruments); its value, chngPer 0.09, is Tradejini's.
